h1: Plumber in Leeds - Emergency Callouts, Boiler Repairs & Installations
h2: Meet the P Adams Team - 20 Years of Trusted Service
Local plumbing services in the Leeds area
Need help with your plumbing or heating?
paragraphs: Heat back on. Hot water running. A new boiler that won't let you down. Whether it's an emergency callout or a planned install, Peter's been looking after Leeds homes since 2003.
Looking after your home's plumbing needs with professional care and attention to detail. Whether it's a quick repair or a full installation, we're here to help.

No heat, no hot water, or a fault code on the display? Call Peter direct – he’ll talk through what’s wrong, give you guidance on what’s likely involved, and book a visit. For boiler emergencies, he’ll usually get to you the same day.

If your boiler is past its best or the repair cost doesn’t add up, we’ll talk you through a replacement that fits your home and budget. Peter installs across all major brands and is accredited by Ideal and Vaillant, with manufacturer-backed warranties up to 10 years on selected models.
All major boiler brands supplied and fitted
Led by Gas Safe registered engineer Peter Adams, our family business has built its reputation on honest pricing, meticulous attention to detail, and treating every customer like family.

With over 20 years of experience working on major commercial projects including Pure Gym installations, Peter established our practice to focus on what matters most - providing exceptional service to local families. As a father of two young children, Peter understands the importance of a warm, safe home and the urgency when things go wrong.

Our team includes trusted apprentice plumbers and skilled colleagues who share our commitment to quality. With 372 Checkatrade reviews averaging 9.51/10, we're dedicated to getting the job done right, first time, every time.
Burst pipes, boiler breakdowns, heating failures – we’re here when you need us most.

Real plumbing emergencies need a real plumber — not a call centre passing your job around. Peter answers his own phone, gets a steer on what’s wrong, and gets to you fast. Most jobs are sorted on the first visit.
